description: This file defines the 'API' class which manages communication, task handling, and configuration for a VSCode extension, integrating with external IPC and webview components.

classes.name: API
classes.description: A class managing communication, task lifecycle, and configuration for a VSCode extension, integrating with IPC and webview components.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the API class, sets up IPC server if socketPath is provided, and registers event listeners.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's emit to broadcast task events via IPC.

methods.name: startNewTask
methods.description: Starts a new task, optionally opening in a new tab, and creates a task with specified configuration.

methods.name: resumeTask
methods.description: Resumes a task from history by its ID.

methods.name: isTaskInHistory
methods.description: Checks if a task ID exists in history.

methods.name: getCurrentTaskStack
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack of tasks.

methods.name: clearCurrentTask
methods.description: Clears the current task stack.

methods.name: cancelCurrentTask
methods.description: Cancels the active task.

methods.name: cancelTask
methods.description: Cancels a specific task by ID.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the webview.

methods.name: pressPrimaryButton
methods.description: Simulates pressing the primary button in the webview.

methods.name: pressSecondaryButton
methods.description: Simulates pressing the secondary button in the webview.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks if the extension view is launched and ready.

methods.name: registerListeners
methods.description: Registers event listeners for task lifecycle events.

methods.name: outputChannelLog
methods.description: Logs messages to the output channel with serialization handling.

methods.name: fileLog
methods.description: Appends log messages to a file if logging is enabled.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves current extension configuration, excluding secret keys.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Updates extension configuration and posts new state to webview.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Returns list of profile names.

methods.name: getProfileEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a profile entry by name.

methods.name: createProfile
methods.description: Creates a new profile with a given name.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates an existing profile.

methods.name: upsertProfile
methods.description: Creates or updates a profile.

methods.name: deleteProfile
methods.description: Deletes a profile by name.

methods.name: getActiveProfile
methods.description: Returns the name of the active profile.

methods.name: setActiveProfile
methods.description: Sets a profile as active by name.
